question: Which organisation released the State of the World’s Children report, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNICEF**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **UNICEF** (United Nations Children's Fund) is the organization responsible for releasing the **State of the World's Children report.**
 
• The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the challenges faced by children worldwide, focusing on themes like health, education, nutrition, and safety.
 
• UNICEF was established in 1946 and works across 190 countries and territories to protect the rights of children and promote their well-being.
 
• The **State of the World's Children report** highlights issues such as child poverty, malnutrition, access to education, and the impact of climate change on children.
 
• UNICEF collaborates with governments, NGOs, and local communities to implement policies and programs that address the issues highlighted in the report.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNDP** (United Nations Development Programme):

 
 
• UNDP works to eradicate poverty and reduce inequalities through sustainable development initiatives.
 
• Its focus areas include governance, climate change adaptation, disaster risk reduction, and poverty alleviation.
 
• While UNDP publishes reports like the **Human Development Report**, it is not responsible for the State of the World's Children report.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO** (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization):
 
 
• UNESCO focuses on promoting international collaboration in education, science, and culture.
 
• It is known for reports such as the **Global Education Monitoring Report**, but it does not release the State of the World's Children report.
 
• UNESCO works to enhance access to quality education and preserve cultural heritage worldwide.
 
 
 
• **WHO** (World Health Organization):
 
 
• WHO is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for public health.
 
• It publishes reports like the **World Health Statistics** and provides guidelines for global health standards.
 
• WHO addresses issues such as pandemics, maternal health.
